line: Closing a ward keeps your reason and time if the save is refused, and reopening a ward now asks you to confirm.
The Activity feed now shows recent actions from every computer at your desk, not just this one.
Capacity now counts locked beds within the total and labels each figure the same way on every screen.
The referral form's side panel now shows what's left to fill in before you can send.
Update a bed now lets you choose a ward, then opens that ward's page.
Bed map squares on Capacity now open that ward's bed board.
Acknowledge visible now asks you to confirm, then lets you undo for a few seconds.
Plan next return now opens the patient longest past discharge with no plan.
Marking a seclusion room available or out of service now asks you to confirm first.
The ED wait labels on Movements rows now say Long wait and Over target instead of Due soon and Overdue.
The Demo chip now shows the ward clock time, such as Demo 14:20, instead of a seconds counter.
Statutory form codes now show their title, such as Form 4A (Transport order), in more places.
Help now has a search box: type what you need to find guides, shortcuts and settings.
Help now has a colour code guide under Reference in the Glossary tab, showing what each colour and shape means.
After you register and refer a patient, the message now has an Open patient button.
Tomorrow tiles now say which bed type they count, and All EDs shows how many EDs match.
The Transport page heading is now the screen name, Transport, instead of a count.
Place or move now explains what Pulled means, with a link to the Help glossary.
Bed drawer: the Stay tile now shows the day of the stay, for example "Day 37".
Home is back at the top of the side menu on a computer, with a house icon.
